title: How to Set a Digital Marketing Budget

facts.fact: The page cites a third-party projection (swordandthescript.com) that marketing spending will reach nearly 13% of revenue by 2025.
facts.quote: marketing spending projected to hit nearly [13%]

facts.fact: The page gives a general guideline that small businesses should spend 7-8% of revenue on marketing.
The page gives a general guideline that mid-sized companies should spend 10-12% of revenue on marketing.
The page cites Gartner's 2024 CMO Spend Survey (third-party) for an overall average marketing budget of 8% of revenue.
facts.quote: Overall average: 8%, per [Gartner’s 2024 CMO Spend Survey]
